note: The session's web search allowance ran out after the first six candidates, so the rest were looked up only on pages whose address could be reached without a search: each school district's and city's own board page, the county courts' pages. Not reached: the Governor's press releases (the state's site refuses scripts), Ballotpedia (empty answer to scripts), the U.S. Taxpayers Party's site (drawn by script, no text), St. Clair County's district court page (password notice), the Port Huron radio station's articles on Judge Mona S. Armstrong's 2020 appointment (the pages would not open, so nothing is recorded for her). No campaign website, birth year, party endorsement or past party label was looked up for anyone after the searches ran out: the five House candidates, the two U.S. Taxpayers candidates, Jennifer E. Fields and Senator Bellino's campaign site are all untouched. Not listed on their district's board page today (so likely not sitting members, or the page is drawn by script): Richard Bell (Cedar Springs), Kurt Troutman (Lake Shore), William Zerbst (Greenville, page not found), Beau Taylor (Troy), Chris Reed (Jenison), Roxine Kemp (Mattawan), Michael Cook (Northville). A blank here means not looked up or not found, not that nothing exists.
